definitions.abnormal: value < referenceLow or value > referenceHigh (the API does not flag abnormality).
definitions.clearlyAbnormal: out of range AND (analyte in neutrophils, white-cell-count, haemoglobin, potassium, creatinine, egfr, hba1c, crp, alt, bilirubin OR value beyond the bound by more than 1.2 x the reference width).
definitions.action: task, outgoing conversation entry (message to patient), appointment startsAt, encounter, or test order with time after the result's createdAt.
definitions.ruleA: abnormal result >= 30 sim days old with no action in the 30 days after it; results < 30 days old are 'pending' and excluded.
definitions.ruleB: >= 2 consecutive abnormal observations of the same analyte (rising: alt, creatinine, hba1c, crp; falling: egfr, haemoglobin), each worse than the last, first-to-last span >= 90 days, no action after the latest.
definitions.ruleC: appointment status in noshow/cancelled/dna with no later appointment carrying the same title.
